correctness.rationale: The hierarchy (1,2,3,5) is correct. Independently over GF(9)=GF(3)[i]/(i^2+1), the three generator rows of the x-i primary component have full GF(3) rank-support dimension four. The combinations i*r0+r1=(1,0,1,0) and i*r1+r2=(0,1,0,1) give a two-dimensional base-field subcode, hence component weights (1,2,4). The (x+1)^2 component is one-dimensional with weight one. Applying the published direct-sum convolution gives (1,2,3,5).
